static long long comb(int n, int c) {
    if (c > n) return 0;
    if (c == n) return 1;
    long long ans = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < c; i++) {
        ans *= (n - i);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= c; i++) {
        ans /= i;
    }
    return ans;
}

static double cal(int m, int n) {
    long long ttl = comb(n, 3);
    double ans = 0.0;
    ans += (double)comb(m, 3);
    ans += (double)(comb(m, 2) * comb(n - m, 1));
    ans += 0.5 * (comb(m, 1) * comb(n - m, 2));
    return ans / ttl;
}


static void solve() {
    int n = i();
    double p = d();

    int l = 0;
    int r = n - 1;
    while (l < r) {
        int m = (l + r) / 2;
        double x = cal(m, n);
        if (x >= p) {
            r = m;
        } else {
            l = m + 1;
        }
    }
    cout << l << "\n";
}

int main() {
    int tt = 1;
    while (tt-- > 0) {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
